files.rationale: Both PRs added the same FastMCP server module with the same CLI (--host, --port 8100, --agent-type codact/react) and streamable-HTTP intent, so PR B's version is kept because it uses the real FastMCP v2.3+ API (FastMCP, server.tool, run(transport="streamable-http")), matching the fastmcp>=2.3.0 requirement PR A documents, and it provides create_fastmcp_server, which src/api/api.py imports, whereas PR A's FastMCPServer/create_app API does not exist.
